```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(6666)  

# Load the dataset
airfare_data <- read.csv("/Users/annatran/Downloads/Airfares.csv",header = TRUE)
head(airfare_data, 10)
# data cleaning
airfare_data <- airfare_data[, -c(1:4)]

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(airfare_data))

trainIndex <- createDataPartition(airfare_data$FARE, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
train_df <- airfare_data[trainIndex, ]
validation_df <- airfare_data[-trainIndex, ]
```

```{r}
install.packages ("corrgram")
# Load necessary library
library(corrgram)

# Use corrgram to visualize relationships
# Select numerical columns only for correlation analysis
numerical_columns <- train_df[, sapply(train_df, is.numeric)]

# Generate a corrgram for the numerical predictors
corrgram(numerical_columns, order = TRUE, lower.panel = panel.shade, upper.panel = panel.pie,
         text.panel = panel.txt, main = "Correlation Matrix of Numerical Variables")

# Alternatively: Compute the correlation matrix for numerical variables
cor_matrix <- cor(numerical_columns, use = "complete.obs")

# Print the correlation matrix
print("Correlation Matrix:")
print(cor_matrix)

# Identify the single best predictor for FARE (highest absolute correlation)
best_predictor <- names(which.max(abs(cor_matrix["FARE", -which(colnames(cor_matrix) == "FARE")])))
cat("The best single predictor of FARE is:", best_predictor, "\n")

```



3. 
```{r}
install.packages ("forecast")
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)

linear_model <- lm(FARE ~ ., data = train_df)
summary(linear_model)

# Align factor levels in validation_df with train_df
for (col in names(train_df)) {
  if (is.factor(train_df[[col]])) {
    validation_df[[col]] <- factor(validation_df[[col]], levels = levels(train_df[[col]]))
  }
}
levels(train_df$S_CITY)
levels(validation_df$S_CITY)
str(validation_df)

# Predict FARE for validation_df using the linear model
validation_df$Predicted_FARE <- predict(linear_model, newdata = validation_df)

# View predictions
head(validation_df[, c("FARE", "Predicted_FARE")])

# Calculate error metrics
actual <- validation_df$FARE
predicted <- validation_df$Predicted_FARE

mae <- mean(abs(actual - predicted))  # Mean Absolute Error
rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))  # Root Mean Squared Error
mape <- mean(abs((actual - predicted) / actual)) * 100  # Mean Absolute Percentage Error

# Print error metrics
cat("Mean Absolute Error (MAE):", mae, "\n")
cat("Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE):", rmse, "\n")
cat("Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE):", mape, "%\n")

```
